findings.title: Require a bijection from COMMAND/CAPTURE originals to audited records
findings.evidence: COMMAND events are counted against legacy_commands, but each row only has to be a member of END.result.command_records. Extra returned records are ignored by replay and failure retention. CAPTURE allocation is compared only to legacy_frames; only before/terminal frames are reconstructed, and no set equality joins all CAPTURE D events to frames/allocated acquisition IDs.
findings.impact: An original command failure/foreign command or an unrepresented CAPTURE inside the reviewed window can be omitted from the audited inventory while coverage remains STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE. Fixed UNKNOWN authority does not make the structural claim correct.
bounded_case_proposals: Starting from existing complete handwritten fixture, append one distinct accepted command record to a COMMAND END result without adding a legacy_commands row; repack only the new test originals. Require INCOMPLETE and a precise unmatched-command reason.
Same counterexample with accepted=false and an explicit original rejection reason; require retention in original_failures, not only generic INCOMPLETE.

Insert one otherwise well-formed CAPTURE D event between the two HOLD physics operations, plus its backend BEGIN/END and legacy operation/interval rows; renumber affected operation/sequence/token/bracket references consistently, but omit its legacy_frame and allocated_acquisition_id. Require INCOMPLETE and preserve the missing capture denominator.
findings.requested_change: Plan exact unique mapping and payload inventory checks for COMMAND and every relevant CAPTURE, preserving extra/rejected/pending records and missing allocated records; do not repair by filtering originals.

findings.title: Join attempt/HOLD interval clocks to the operations they claim to contain
findings.evidence: Intervals only require start_step<=end_step and start[0]<end[0]. Purpose membership later uses step labels and parent IDs. Neither purpose nor attempt original start/end clock tuples are tied to child operation clocks. The preopen check is a tautology after window_events was filtered to begin_seq>before.end_seq.
findings.impact: An attempt can be recorded as opened before the selected preopen capture, or a HOLD interval can be recorded entirely after the terminal capture, yet the same labeled physics rows still qualify as execution/HOLD coverage.
bounded_case_proposals: Copy the complete fixture and move only the HOLD purpose interval original start/end clock tuples to ordered times strictly after terminal; keep step121..123 and IDs unchanged. Repack and require INCOMPLETE for temporal containment.

Copy the complete fixture and move the attempt interval start clock tuple before the before-CAPTURE boundary while retaining the current valid end. Repack and require INCOMPLETE for preopen/dispatch binding.
findings.requested_change: Plan a source-supported association between purpose/attempt interval boundary evidence, child operation intervals, D order and before/terminal captures. Verify temporal containment and actual preopen ordering; do not infer it solely from step labels or a filtered operation set.

findings.title: Validate complete RawV3 record fields instead of only dataclass field names
findings.evidence: The loop takes RawV3 dataclass field names but validates only exact keys and record_seq. It never reconstructs the typed record or performs its field checks. action_window reads only success/error_code/action_type/details.physics_steps from returned_result and compares action.attempt by == to preregistration attempt.
findings.impact: A truncated executor returned_result can count as an original complete successful return; action.attempt=true compares equal to integer1. Existing TypedActionSpanV3 validation requires complete ActionResult fields, integer duration and aware timestamps, and rejects bool attempt.
bounded_case_proposals: Replace the complete fixture returned_result with only success=true, error_code=null, action_type=MOVE_ABOVE and details.physics_steps=1. Repack and require INCOMPLETE while preserving the allocated action denominator.
Set only legacy_actions[0].attempt=true with preregistration attempt remaining integer1. Repack and require rejection/INCOMPLETE according to the planned malformed-subrecord contract.
findings.requested_change: Plan strict schema/type/value validation for consumed action, command, interval and acquisition records, reusing RawV3 rules where compatible. Preserve identifiable missing subrecords as INCOMPLETE with denominators rather than treating equality/coercion as validation.

source_fact_correction.prior_plan_claim_incorrect: COMMAND result lacks physics_state and therefore cannot MARK
source_fact_correction.correct_fact: Result is initialized with physics_state, then COMMAND adds command_records.
source_fact_correction.next_plan_requirement: Correct current summaries and align handwritten COMMAND fixture with actual result layout; preserve F1-F3 and investigate joins without claiming live producer success.
